title: Taurus and Our Place
old_caption: Three dates, same spot, same bread. Taurus calls it a routine. The friends call it cute. Do you have an "our place" yet?

title: Pisces at the Puppy Party
old_caption: Pisces cried at a puppy's birthday and had receipts: the tiny hat, the singing, and being called "my person." By the end, everyone was crying. Valid, right?

title: They Remembered Her Name
old_caption: Mentioned your sister once, three weeks ago. They asked about her new job by name. Taurus has never recovered. What's the smallest thing that won you over?

title: Take Your Time
old_caption: Libra holding two menus like a life decision, and the date just leans back: no rush. Some people are built different. Which sign needs this patience the most?

title: Home Safe?
old_caption: "home safe?" and then they actually wait up for the answer. Sagittarius pretends to be cool about it. Sagittarius is not cool about it. Who checks in on you?

title: Bragging Out Loud
old_caption: When their friends say "FINALLY" because they've heard all about you already. Virgo, blushing in real time. Tag someone who brags about the people they love.

title: Excited About Your Thing
old_caption: Aquarius shows off the rock collection and the date asks to see the sparkly one again. That's the whole review. What's your thing people should get excited about?

title: Choose Your Party Plus-One
old_caption: Leo works the room, Virgo has a backup gift, and Pisces cries at the toast. The cursor knew what it wanted. Who's your pick for the holiday party?

title: Choose Your Road-Trip Co-Pilot
old_caption: Sagittarius has a "shortcut," Capricorn printed the route twice, and Cancer packed your snacks with labels. Pick your co-pilot. Comments are open.

title: Choose Your First-Date Planner
old_caption: Aries picked the place four minutes ago. Taurus booked the comfy booth. Scorpio found somewhere you can actually hear each other. Which planner are you?
